app.artifact_location: https://github.com/tevo-studio/tinos-mobile/pull/12 (proof APK SHA and signer are recorded in the PR evidence)

service.admin_status_changes: loopback /admin GET and /admin/status POST; require local test header, exact Origin, and observed package/certificate pair

scenarios.approved: LicenseResult.Licensed; server row stays approved; zero SDK denial logs
scenarios.pending: LicenseResult.NotLicensed; server row stays pending; one SDK denial log
scenarios.revoked: LicenseResult.NotLicensed; server row stays revoked; one SDK denial log
scenarios.offline-no-cache: LicenseResult.Unverified transport failure; app remains usable; service is stopped
scenarios.debug-pending: NOT-RUN: debuggable client returns LicenseResult.Licensed without contacting the service; server-seen acceptance is unresolved

observation.case_log_scope: new launch PID only; filter the SDK denial tag, level and message
observation.online_server_freshness: record the pair last_seen before launch and require a strictly later value after launch

initialization.reason: The pinned sample publishes the typed license callback result, but it has no observable that proves runtime construction succeeded or was denied.

debug_case_input.required: A debuggable APK that routes to the X99 license-test endpoint
debug_case_input.reason: The pinned licenseProof build is non-debuggable and defines the emulator HTTP endpoint only for that build type.
debug_case_input.disposition: NOT-RUN until a compatible APK is pinned

fixture_reset.before_each_suite: start a fresh task-owned Compose project with the license-test profile
fixture_reset.offline_case: stop only the task-owned license-test service; this is the final case
